name: ph1-brain
description: Ph1 company second brain: drop anything into raw/, a librarian agent builds a linked wiki every Claude session can use

brain_path.title: Brain folder
brain_path.description: Where the brain lives on this computer (holds raw/ and wiki/). ~ means your user folder.

auto_ingest.title: Ingest automatically
auto_ingest.description: Process new files in raw/ in the background at session start and every few minutes. Off: you get a notice and run /brain-ingest yourself.

claude_md.title: Tell every session about the brain
claude_md.description: Keep a short marked 'Ph1 second brain' section in your personal CLAUDE.md (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md) so every Claude Code session and agent knows where the brain is. Turn off to remove it.
